label: ThinkPad X1 Extreme Gen 6
description: 16-inch performance ThinkPad with 13th-gen Core HX and RTX 40 graphics, two Thunderbolt 4, SD Express and Wi-Fi 6E.
notes: No RJ45 - the X1 Extreme dropped the jack, so wired is Thunderbolt-dock only at 1GbE. Wi-Fi 6E AX211 onboard; a heavy host that still cannot be cabled directly.
